decisions.label: SC-8
decisions.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
decisions.rationale: TLS protects transmission when the deployment mounts it; the image serves plain HTTP on 8080 otherwise.

decisions.label: SC-8(1)
decisions.title: Cryptographic Protection
decisions.rationale: As SC-8: TLS 1.2 and 1.3, when the deployment mounts it.

decisions.label: SC-10
decisions.title: Network Disconnect
decisions.rationale: Idle connections close after nginx's keepalive timeout; the deployment may set its own.

decisions.label: SC-13
decisions.title: Cryptographic Protection
decisions.rationale: nginx uses OpenSSL as shipped by Red Hat. The standard makes no FIPS claim, and its position on images that protect CUI is open.

decisions.label: SC-18
decisions.title: Mobile Code
decisions.rationale: Any script in the served content is the deployment's content, not the image's.

decisions.label: SC-23
decisions.title: Session Authenticity
decisions.rationale: Session authenticity is TLS, when the deployment mounts it.

decisions.label: SI-4(10)
decisions.title: Visibility of Encrypted Communications
decisions.rationale: The image does not monitor traffic; that is the platform's (PLT-16).

decisions.label: SI-8
decisions.title: Spam Protection
decisions.rationale: The image handles no mail.

decisions.label: SI-8(2)
decisions.title: Automatic Updates
decisions.rationale: The image handles no mail.

decisions.label: SI-10
decisions.title: Information Input Validation
decisions.rationale: nginx rejects malformed requests, but no criterion yet evidences it.

decisions.label: SI-11
decisions.title: Error Handling
decisions.rationale: server_tokens is off, so errors do not disclose the version, but no criterion yet evidences error handling.
